dict.string: NotchDeck listens to what's playing so the media waveform moves with the music, and so you can set each app's volume. Audio is processed on this Mac as it plays and is never recorded.
NotchDeck works Music and Spotify from the notch, and switches your Mac between light and dark appearance through System Events. It only sends the commands you ask for.
NotchDeck shows the weather where you are. Your location is rounded and only used to fetch the forecast.

NotchDeck finds Android phones on your Wi-Fi so you can share files with them using Quick Share. It uses your local network only, never the internet.
